title: Intern with Lawfare!
gist: Lawfare announces a paid, hybrid Spring 2027 editorial internship paying $18.40 per hour, running Jan. 8 to May 30, 2027, with applications closing Nov. 23, 2026. The post contains no market-relevant analysis.
